review_policy: Learner-facing and strategic approval requires explicit independent human review. Deterministic checks may reject stale, invalid, or out-of-scope mutations but can never create an approval.

final_composition.note: The current review corpus includes the prior strategy, drill, continuity, anti-guessing, stimulus-generalisation, diagnostic-feedback, full learner-language and poker-native terminology repairs, the decision-comprehension closure, the Practical Mastery gateway, the final Practical Mastery RU presentation repairs, the bounded C2-C4 Practical Mastery assessment-integrity repair including final bilingual distractor and answer-length balancing, the bounded V5-observed Practical Mastery RU final-polish pass, and the canonical root cutover to /mastery/journey with the hardened legacy shell retained under /tools. Stable module/drill/card/decision/option IDs, correct answers, scoring, mastery, scheduler, retention, field evidence and learner state remain unchanged; only the already-governed assessment misconception tags and bounded learner-facing wording repairs changed. Strategy, drills, exact RU/EN human review and final composition approval remain pending; deterministic source locks, CI and machine/agent review are rejection evidence only and are not human approval. The V6 Wave C bounded feedback-depth and Russian morphology publication repair is included without changing scoring, scheduler, mastery, learner state, or human approval truth. The V7 pre-blind Real Hands post-capture draft-continuity repair is included without changing evidence semantics, scoring, mastery, scheduler, retention, or human approval truth. The pre-blind B3 assessment-integrity closure adds deterministic balanced option composition only; decision/option IDs, correct answers, RU/EN semantics, changed-node identity, scoring, mastery thresholds, scheduler and evidence semantics remain unchanged. The Blind V2 bounded publication repair rewrites the W4-HAND-01 combo-to-family explanations from curriculum-design vocabulary to direct poker mechanism and adds a deterministic RU interrogative gender-agreement rule to the final polish pass; decision/option IDs, correct answers, misconception tags, scoring, mastery, scheduler, retention and changed-node identity remain unchanged. The V3 post-blind bounded RU publication repair fixes the final-polish generator rule that mistook the standalone poker Ace-rank label "A" (e.g. "A-high") for the English indefinite article and deleted it, and adds bounded exact-string overrides for the demonstrated untranslated-fragment and internal-vocabulary defects ("Hand имеет equity, но может fold до showdown", "Какой component", "node context"); decision/option IDs, correct answers, misconception tags, scoring, mastery, scheduler, retention and evidence semantics remain unchanged. The RU publication-quality closure translates the untranslated hybrid RU/EN FND-01 boundary and FND-02/FND-03/FND-06 sibling decision text in decisions-foundation-expansion.ts and decisions-gap-fill.ts into natural Russian, fixes a case-agreement bug in the learner-presentation firewall's "practice topic" replacement and in the "raw equity" exact-string overrides for its two active FND-02 call sites, and extends the existing evidence-predicate pluralisation map with two newly observed verbs; decision/option IDs, correct answers, misconception tags, sourceRefs, scoring, mastery, scheduler, retention and evidence semantics remain unchanged. The final-educational-integrity-certification P2 closure fixes four bounded presentation/semantic-parity defects: five decisions-blind-defence-expansion.ts RU learner surfaces (PM-BL-01-103/105/106, PM-BL-02-105, PM-BL-04-103) that left the English words "fringe"/"rake" untranslated despite an established Russian rendering used elsewhere in the same corpus; the wave4r-final-language.ts EN aggression theory bullet, which had lost the RU-only value/best-bluffs/hybrids low-SPR jamming-range composition detail during the English-only final language pass; an internal source-family name ("Carrot") that leaked into the agg-05 EN explanation in wave3-priority-gold.ts; and decisions-srp-a6-expansion.ts item PM-OOP-04-106, whose EN cue omitted the concrete 25-33% sizing anchor that the RU cue states. Decision/option IDs, correct-answer IDs, misconception tags, scoring, mastery, scheduler, retention, poker strategy and numeric formulas remain unchanged; only presentation-layer RU/EN text changed.
